Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between UX and UI design?

UX design focuses on the overall experience and usability of a product, while UI design focuses on the visual and interactive elements. We do both, ensuring a seamless connection between how a product works and how it looks.

Do you conduct user research?

Yes. User research is the foundation of our process. We conduct interviews, surveys, usability testing, and analytics analysis to inform every design decision.

What is a design system?

A design system is a collection of reusable components, patterns, and guidelines that ensures consistency and efficiency across digital products.

How do you measure design success?

We measure success through usability metrics, user satisfaction scores, conversion rates, and business KPIs aligned with your goals.
